title: Describe undo public preconditions and result shapes

findings.fact: kizuki undo has no --json envelope. Unknown --json is a usage error (exit 2).
findings.invariant: docs/cli.md describes --json as a general CLI envelope; undo does not implement it.

findings.fact: RFC 0002 §16.4 says the undo result states that purged events are not resurrected. Current undo stdout is only the five key=value lines. The sentence lives on kizuki purge.
findings.invariant: P023/P043 must not invent an undo resurrection line.

findings.fact: If current hash equals before_hash/ABSENT and differs from after_hash, undo completes instead of page_changed. RFC §7.2 step 2 does not describe this interrupted-retry path; tests 316-428 do.
SourceGrantError, CanonWriteError (erased page_path), and missing vault use stderr prefix `error:`. UndoError does not.
findings.invariant: Callers must branch on prefix and exit, not on a printed code.

findings.fact: App undo success is {receipt_id, message:'Receipt undone.'}. UndoError codes are absent from the AppError allow-list, so failures become unavailable/retryable.
findings.invariant: P043 must not assume CLI UndoError text on the app route.

findings.fact: CLI already covers success undo, unknown, already-reverted, and help. It does not cover cascade, page_changed, not_undoable, or undo arity. Core already covers the engine. This packet does not add tests.
